data.name: Sunset Trail Ride
data.headline: 1 hour sunset trail ride at the ranch. 8 yrs+
data.description:
Enjoy a beautiful walk ride near our ranch here in Joshua Tree. This experience is one of a kind in the desert as we walk into the sunset at golden hour. This is a peaceful way to end your day!







Max weight (240 lbs)

meeting_point.address: 6353 Cascade Rd Joshua Tree, CA US 92252

data.cancellation_notes:
We ask that you arrive 30 minutes before your scheduled ride time. If you are not here by the rides departure, you will not be accommodated or refunded. 
If you would like to cancel your reservation, we can offer a gift certificate for the full payment. 
If the reservation is cancelled within 7 days of the booking date then there will be a $25 fee per rider if a gift certificate is not preferred.
Same day cancellations/ no shows will not be refunded or accommodated.
data.booking_notes:
Thank you for booking! Please come prepared with water, close toed shoes, and leggings/ pants. Arrive 30 minutes before your ride unless asked otherwise. 

Bringing carrots is highly recommended! You can reward your horse after the ride (: 

Our address is: 
6353 Cascade Rd 
Joshua Tree, CA 92252
data.pricing:
$160 per rider
Give us a call if you are a local or if your group is 5 or more for group discounts!
